preserveExactly.factorial: 3 G levels x 4 N levels x 4 F levels = 48 core cells
preserveExactly.pairingOrderMetricsGatesAndStoppingRules: unchanged except coordinates and hashes that must bind to the approved new maxima

predeclaredV2Candidates.rationale: Approximately equal 1.5x upper step on all three axes; G and N are multiples of 64 and F is 11 squared.
More runtime margin while retaining F=12 squared; G remains a multiple of 16.
Retain more F-axis span with F=13 squared while controlling the stronger N driver.
First-screen fallback with the largest modeled runtime margin.

runtimeMethod.formal: Identical to v1: per-algorithm multilinear interpolation of log process-wall P50/maximum over log2 G/N/F; add pooled gap P50/P99; B=36; conservative x 1.20 planning headroom.
runtimeMethod.qualificationLaneStage: Three core lanes per algorithm x cell plus eighteen stress lanes per algorithm. New stress P50/maximum equals interpolated new high-corner core value multiplied by that algorithm's observed old stress/core high-corner ratio; add 972 gaps.
runtimeMethod.qualificationBoundary: Lane-stage only. Instrument, oracle, empty-boundary, structural validation, delivery, and finalization are not included and no exact full-acquisition ETA is claimed.

recommendationRule: Recommend PRIMARY_AXIS_BALANCED if its B=36 planning budget is below 168 hours. Otherwise recommend, in order, MARGIN_F144, HIGHER_F_SPAN, or MAXIMUM_MARGIN if below 168 hours. Recommendation remains a proposal requiring explicit user approval and a new refreeze.
